translation_direction: ja → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Japanese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Dialogue stays embedded in the narration without quotation marks, and Ichiyō’s long comma-linked periods are kept.
decisions.rationale: The run-on gabun is the work’s music.

decisions.decision: Chōkichi tao/mày; Nobu tớ/cậu; Shōta em/chị Midori with Midori and tao/mày only in his outburst; Midori tớ with friends and tôi/các người in the brawl.
decisions.rationale: The children’s registers mark gang, class and feeling.

decisions.decision: Narration uses Midori, Nobu and Shōta; the full name Fujimoto Nobuyuki appears at his introduction.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: 罪の無き子 no longer the wrong idiom vô tội vạ.
Shōta comes to Midori’s pillow and puts his hands on his own knees; ‘knee’ and ‘thigh’ errors removed.
華魁 as oiran, not hoa khôi, in Shōta’s line about Midori’s destiny; 寮, 萬燈, nicknames and colours unified across the drafting parts.
茶屋が棧橋 as the plank bridges behind the teahouses; かわ色, 紙雛, 弓張提燈 and 學林 corrected or de-calqued.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: phe Phố Trước / phe Ngõ Bên
glossary.rationale: The two children’s gangs keep fixed names through the festival brawl and after.

glossary.source_term: 紅入り友仙の切れ端 / 鼻緒 / 水仙の作り花
glossary.draft_rendering: mảnh lụa yūzen điểm đỏ / quai guốc / bông thủy tiên giả
glossary.rationale: The three objects of the rain scene and the ending keep one name each.
Hoa khôi would read as ‘beauty queen’; Midori’s destiny depends on the word.

witness_decision: Selected the Aozora Bunko transcription (card 55671, file 55671_64594) of the complete revised text as reprinted in 文藝倶樂部 第二卷第五編 (April 1896), in old kanji and kana. First serialised in 文學界, nos. 25–37 (January 1895 – January 1896); not collated. Aozora notes recording corrections of the base text are applied as transcribed.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Narration occasionally calls Midori cô rather than cô bé before her change.

title_review.rationale: Tuổi thơ so vai keeps the image of children measuring themselves against each other and the loss of childhood that たけくらべ implies; Đọ chiều cao would read as the name of a game.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Opening survey of the quarter keeps its irony.
The paper narcissus ending kept quiet and exact.
